for _ in range(num_merges):
    pairs = list(zip(tokens, tokens[1:]))
    a, b = max(pairs, key=pairs.count)
    i, out = 0, []
    while i < len(tokens):
        hit = tokens[i:i + 2] == [a, b]
        out.append(a + b if hit else tokens[i])
        i += 2 if hit else 1
    tokens = out
    print(f"合并 {(a + b).decode()!r}，剩 {len(tokens)} 个词元")
